theme_and_concept.name: KasirKu POS
theme_and_concept.description: Mobile-first POS cashier and desktop dashboard tailored for Indonesian warungs. Prioritizes massive touch targets, ultra-high contrast, and operational clarity.
theme_and_concept.key_features: Cashier grid, cart bottom sheet, dual-accent color logic, big summary cards, minimalist charts.

rules: Use wide-tracked uppercase for tiny labels (tracking-[0.2em]).
All headings must have tight letter spacing.

layouts.mobile_cashier: Strictly mobile-first. Fixed top header (Search/Categories). Scrollable middle (Product Grid 2-3 cols). Fixed bottom sheet for Cart & massive 'Bayar' button. Use full-screen modals for numerical input.
layouts.desktop_dashboard: Sidebar on left (w-64). Main content area right. High-density grid for metrics but with large typography. Recharts container must be minimal.
layouts.spacing: Scale up spacing. Use p-6 to p-8 inside cards. Gap-4 to Gap-6 for grids.

components.buttons: Must be min-h-[56px]. rounded-xl, font-bold, text-lg. Use money_green for 'Bayar/Cash/Checkout' and primary_action_blue for 'Save/Next/Add'.
components.inputs: Must be min-h-[56px]. rounded-xl, text-lg, border-2 border-slate-200. Focus state: border-primary_action_blue ring-4 ring-primary_action_blue/20.
components.cards: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm. Inner padding p-6. No aggressive shadows.
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog. Backdrop must be backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-900/40. Modal body rounded-2xl sm:rounded-3xl p-6.
components.charts: Recharts for 7-day summary. Hide CartesianGrid lines. Use a single solid stroke (money_green) with Area gradient underneath. Minimal tooltip.
components.onboarding_wizard: 4 steps: Shop Info -> QRIS Upload -> Printer Pairing -> First Product. Use large progress indicators and full-screen step layouts.

motion.hover_states: Buttons and Cards: hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md transition-transform duration-200 ease-out.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for product grids and list items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on green/blue buttons meets WCAG AA.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 56px height and width for all interactive elements.
accessibility.focus_management: Visible focus rings on all inputs and buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Setup routing for dual interfaces: Mobile Cashier (e.g., /pos) and Desktop Dashboard (e.g., /dashboard).
Install and use 'sonner' for toast notifications.
Implement Shadcn UI components but override heights to min-h-[56px] for touch optimization.
Build the 4-step onboarding wizard using state to track steps.
In the POS grid, show products as large buttons with image (if any) or initials, name, and price.
Use Recharts for the owner dashboard '7-day graph', keeping it minimal and clean.
Ensure 'Bayar' button is persistently visible at the bottom of the POS screen.
Mock Bluetooth thermal printing using a simple console log or alert and WhatsApp reporting via window.open('https://wa.me/...').
All crucial elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='bayar-button', data-testid='login-button').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT add 'text-align: center' to the main App wrapper.
Do NOT use generic 'transition: all'. Explicitly transition transform, opacity, colors.
Do NOT use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays; always use glass-morphism (backdrop-blur-md).
Use large spacing values (p-6, p-8) to avoid a cramped look.
Avoid default 'Vercel-look'. Make it feel like a robust, friendly tool for shop owners.
